Name: Captail Ian McKinnon
Details: Ian McKinnon is the commander of elite The Fox's Teeth, part of the 7th Crucis Lancers. Since his days as a junion MechWarrior, McKinnon has used unconventional tactics to fight successful actions against the CCAF and DCMS. Captain McKinnon is known as independent and unorthodox, and does not like to engage from static, defensive positions.
